about_item: Durable Ripstop Ballistic Cover: The heavy-duty cover withstands scratching, digging, and occasional mouthing or light chewing. Great for dogs that like to get a little rough with their beds! Please note that this is not a chew proof bed and it is not recommended for dogs that chew heavily or constantly on their bedding.
Sofa-Style Bolster Design: The raised pillow walls create a cozy feeling of security and offer your pup a comfy place to rest their head or curl up against.

USA-Made: The bed mattress and bolsters are both made from CertiPUR-US certified shredded foam manufactured in the USA. This foam has been third-party tested to meet rigorous content, durability, and emissions standards, ensuring the quality and longevity of your dog's bed.

Soft Pillow Fill: Our shredded foam makes for a dense but soft filling that allows your dog to sink down into their bedding. Perfect for any pups (big or small!) that like to nest and snuggle into their beds.

Two Fabric Styles: Regular ripstop (Blue Quartz, Obsidian Black, Sandstone) and Premium Finish ripstop (Taupe and Titanium). All are durable; the regular ripstop has a slick, canvas-like texture that is great for outdoor and indoor beds alike, while premium finish ripstop has a faux-woven texture that works best on indoor-only beds.

authors_reviews.title: Best bed we've purchased in years!
authors_reviews.text: We are very happy with our purchase! We were very nervous spending so much money on dog beds since we've bought many dog beds in our Great Dane's lifetime. She gets to digging to make herself comfortable and finds a hole, and then the bed is a goner! So now that we've had ours for over a month with no issues, we are convinced this was worth the money! I think she has probably done some digging at the bed with no success, so she doesn't even try anymore. We purchased a large for our Great Dane, and a medium for our little Boxer mix. A lot of times, our Great Dane will curl up in the medium, and our little one will stretch out in the large, which is pretty funny. We wanted the comfiest of beds because we were getting new furniture and didn't want them to have free reign over the couches anymore while we were gone for the day. These beds are definitely comfy for them! The only reasons I give it 4 instead of 5 stars is because the cushion inside doesn't really stay perfectly, so sometimes the bed is leaning back a little, (if that makes sense) and the loudness/discomfort of the fabric. With that said, I realize the loudness of the fabric is something that comes with the territory when you're getting a bed that will withstand that kind of wear and tear. I think we'll eventually buy a softer cover for the top. Right now, we just drape blankets over the top so it's softer for them, but it just looks messy rather than cozy. When we took the cushion by itself out of the box, our Dane layed on it right away and was in heaven. Once we got it all stuffed in to the bed cover, she wasn't a fan of it until we put blankets over top. I also wished the bed would've come pre-stuffed. My husband and I had an interesting time getting them together, which, after all that, I would think the cushions would fit tighter inside. We are very happy with our purchase! authors_reviews.title: Pricey and a big disappointment.
authors_reviews.text: $145.00. Pricey. I reviewed this originally on 19 April 2018. I purchase the product on 22 March 2018. Initially, It was larger than expected. It seemed sturdy. I thought it might be a winner. I was wrong.My dog is still a bit of a puppy, well, teen aged, based on his sense of humor and tendency to attempt to destroy anything he can when not being watched.My dog spends most of his time in a kennel outside. I wanted him to have bedding that was not messy and comfortable. I tried a different types of bedding when he was much smaller. Fred (the dog's name), yanked the bedding out of his dog house and began shredding the bedding. I tried straw but it turned messy.I continued to look for long term bedding to enhance his comfort. I found K9 Ballistics and read a few reviews and thought this bedding might have a shot at being a survivor. I was wrong. Since my initial 19 April review, my dog ripped a hole in the outer covering. I eventually caught Fred trying to jerk the oversized bedding through the dog house opening, stuffing flying around the kennel. I call that a fail.Unless, one is going to watch a dog 24X7, he'll delight in destruction because he is a dog and it brings them joy. Eventually, he will be trained out of this tendency but until then the K9 Ballistic dog bed does not hold up. It did not survive two months. I am $145.00 disappointed. I cannot recommend this product for an unsupervised dog. See the included pictures.
